title: SignedReceipt
description: Complete signed mission receipt bundle — mirrors the pinned drenyra-ai@0.2.0 SignedReceipt shape field-for-field (REQ-CONTRACTS-004; design §3.3). receiptType and algorithm are bundle metadata and never enter the canonical content bytes.

receiptHash.description: lowercase hex sha-256 over the canonical serialization of content only

signerPublicKey.description: base64 Ed25519 public key; decoded length is enforced by harnesses

signature.description: base64 raw Ed25519 signature (64 bytes); decoded length is enforced by harnesses
